answer_1.quote: The task of generative commonsense inference modeling (COMET; ... asks the model to generate commonsense tails t based on given head h o and relation r inputs.
answer_1.outputs: Commonsense tails (t) for given head (h_o) and relation (r) inputs.

answer_2.quote: We use several automatic metrics for evaluation, including BLEU, ROUGE-L, METEOR, CIDEr, and BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: Meanwhile, four expert annotators are recruited to conduct expert evaluations of the generations. They are asked to annotate the plausibility of 200 randomly selected commonsense triple generations under each setting, and the resulting plausibility rates are reported.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to evaluate the plausibility of generated commonsense triples.
